name: I1. Denial analysis by plan and reason
rawText:
# Do you know whether your business is gaining sales momentum or losing ground over time?
# - How has our monthly revenue changed over the last 10 months?
# - Which months generated the highest and lowest revenue?
# - Are our sales growing or declining compared with the previous month?
# - Which months experienced the biggest revenue increases or drops?
# - How much cumulative revenue have we generated over time?
# - Are our monthly sales showing consistent growth or significant fluctuations?
# - Which months contributed the most to our overall revenue?
# - How many completed orders did we receive each month?
# - Is our business building stronger revenue momentum month after month?
# - Are recent sales trends indicating growth, stagnation, or a potential slowdown?
# __________________________________________________

Claims: Policy.InsurancePlan.Tier Tier,
    Policy.InsurancePlan.Name Plan,
    DenialReason,
    Count(Id) DeniedClaims,
    Sum(BilledAmount).Round(2) BilledAmount,
    Sum(AllowedAmount).Round(2) AllowedAmount,
    Avg(BilledAmount).Round(2) AverageBilledAmount
  Where Status = <Denied>
  Order DeniedClaims DESC, BilledAmount DESC
  Take 10
id: Insurance 1. Denial analysis by plan and reason
